## Introduction

The classic long-life series under the banner of MARRION, launched in January 2013 with MKZ-008 and published to date 70, is over 13 years old. The core concept is "Cute Midget!" I'm not going anywhere. (Sweet face but big ass! I'm not going anywhere. The #.)

The series is directed by the director, Jiro Miyamoto, and uses the female giant as the best selling point, with all kinds of hip close-ups, back-up perspectives and ass-related games. Since 2020, the MKKZ has been replaced by the MKKZ.

## Series Characteristics

- Core selling point: the cute contrast between the twilight and the twilight.
- The entire series was directed by Miyamoto Junior.
- 2013-2020 Issued under MKZ
- From 2020 to the MKKZ.
- The latest MKKZ-164 issue until 2026 continues
